name: hook-dates
description: One entity whose before-hook rejects are gated on a date field compared with a timestamp() literal and with a datetime field, on create from the request and on update from the row the engine hands back. A date compares as midnight UTC of its day; a reject so gated must fire on every engine (pre-flight S-1 and F9-1, #317).

shipments.description: A shipment with a due date and a ship-by instant.

action.reject: The due date is after the ship-by time.
A shipment due before 2027 is frozen.
